meta.title: 戴明星同款帽子享小脸人生！！这帽型抄对了
meta.title_en: Copy the Star Hat Shape for a Slimmer Face

scenes.context: 开场用舞蹈室侧影提出问题：明星戴棒球帽为何不露全脸仍显好看？
sentences: Stars wear caps without showing their faces.
paraphrase: Stars wear caps without showing their faces.
scenes.speak: Stars wear caps without showing their faces. They instantly look beautiful.

scenes.context: 咱们普通人没有精致脸型，戴普通棒球帽容易踩雷，显脸大。
sentences: Ordinary faces often get it wrong.
It makes the face look bigger.
paraphrase: Ordinary faces often get it wrong.
It makes the face look bigger.
scenes.speak: Ordinary faces often get it wrong. It makes the face look bigger.

scenes.context: 主讲人先把自己放进「普通人」一侧，强调没有精致的建模脸，更容易踩雷。
sentences: She claims the ordinary side first.
paraphrase: She claims the ordinary side first.
scenes.speak: She claims the ordinary side first. No finely modeled face.

scenes.context: 普通帽子线头大显脸大，侧面还暴露全骨颧骨下颌，更不好看。
scenes.speak: The side shows the cheekbones. The jawline shows too.

scenes.context: 一定要试试这款升级棒球帽，上脸直接氛围感拉满。
sentences: The upgraded shape maxes out the vibe.
paraphrase: The upgraded shape maxes out the vibe.
scenes.speak: The upgraded shape maxes out the vibe. It instantly flatters the face.

scenes.context: 帽檐比常规款加宽不少，能更好地遮住颧骨和下颌，显得脸小。
sentences: It hides the cheekbones and slims.
paraphrase: It hides the cheekbones and slims.
scenes.speak: The brim is wider. It hides the cheekbones and slims.

scenes.context: 加深帽深贴合耳部，清晰侧脸线条，头包脸的效果更明显。
sentences: A deeper crown hugs the ears.
paraphrase: A deeper crown hugs the ears.
scenes.speak: A deeper crown hugs the ears. The profile looks cleaner.

scenes.context: 就算不是天生上镜脸，也能轻松戴着明星同款头包脸效果。
sentences: Even non-photogenic faces can wear it.
paraphrase: Even non-photogenic faces can wear it.
scenes.speak: Even non-photogenic faces can wear it. Get the head-wrapping-face look.
